source_text: Relativists critique universalist interventions for hypocrisy, noting Western tolerance of analogous body modifications—like male circumcision, performed on over a million U.S. infants annually without equivalent condemnation, or elective cosmetic surgeries such as labiaplasty—while selectively targeting non-Western traditions, thereby revealing culturally biased standards rather than consistent ethical principles.
